rows.reasoning: Pierce voted Nay on SB 1(ss) (2022), which makes abortion 'a criminal act, except when performed under the following circumstances' (health/life, lethal anomaly, rape/incest to 10 weeks). A No on a ban shows he is on the side against banning, but it does not show whether he would 'keep abortion legal at every stage of pregnancy, with no time limit', through the second trimester, or only the first trimester; his forum remarks do not address abortion.
